Composition & Indication

Loratadine 10mg — 60 Tablets contains Loratadine 10 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 60 Tablets at the official 10mg strength. The standard indication is the management of seasonal allergic rhinitis and urticaria, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Loratadine 10mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.
